text:
Eleni K.: FYI I opened a tiny PR to tidy the Optimize toolkit docs: fixes for examples, a short quant note for tiny prompts, and a small batching defaults section. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/507

Tom S.: Linking. Quick scan shows the Python snippet still uses old kwargs for embeddings (embed_model). Will update to model='redwood/opt-1'.

Vik (eng): Also the example that demonstrates KV prefetch points at /internal/prefetch which moved. Suggest replace with ./prefetch-cheatsheet.md and add a relative anchor.

Eleni K.: Good catch. OpsBot, can you run a link check after the change?

OpsBot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.org/507. Link check: 1 broken -> /internal/prefetch.

Rina: I pushed a short quant blurb: "For sequences <64 tokens prefer fp16; use 4-bit only after regression tests pass." Also added a tiny qprofile example to illustrate.

Tom S.: Added Python update. Snippet now: ```python
req = client.Request().model('redwood/opt-1').batching(True)
res = client.generate(req)
``` Compiles in our sample app.

Vik (eng): Perf note: interactive apps do best with a batching window of 20-30ms. Bulk jobs 100-200ms. I left a one-line recommendation in the doc.

Eleni K.: Can we include a one-paragraph example showing fallback routing when batching breaches SLOs? Keep it minimal.

Rina: YAML draft:```yaml
routing:
  policy: low_latency
  fallback:
    - model: redwood/opt-1-lite
      reason: slo_violation
``` I'll add it to the PR.

OpsBot: Re-run link check: 0 broken links. Build ok. Lint: no warnings.

Tom S.: Approving the doc PR. Left one small note to add a changelog bullet.

Eleni K.: I'll add changelog entry: "Optimize: examples updated (SDK migration), batching defaults, KV prefetch link, short-seq quant guidance." Merging after CI completes.

Vik (eng): Post-merge follow-up: I'll file a ticket to update sample apps to the new request builder API.

Eleni K.: Thanks all, closing thread. :smile:
